page.layout: One column of lexicon entries, Hebrew headwords with Latin glosses, set in hanging-indent entries. Printed page number 52 at top right. Running head in Hebrew at top centre. No margin notes.

main_text.p: גְּאֻלָּה[?] f. Redemptio, Vindicia, jus vindi- ciarum.
גֻּבָא[?] m. Lacuna, Fossa: plur. גֻּבָאִים.
גֵּב גבב m. Gibbus, Tergum, Dorsum, Superficies eminens, Eminentia: Fornix.plur.
גִּבִּים Eminentia, Dorsa, Fornices, Crepidines, Apsides, Supercilia. Chald. עַל גַּבָּה In dorso ejus, Dan.7.6.
גבא גב m. Chal. Fovea, Fossa Dan.8.16.17.
גָּבַהּ Altum, Elatum esse, Attollere, Efferre, Exaltare se. Hiphil הִגְבִּיהַ Exaltavit; Exaltare se.
גָּבְדָּה m. Altus, Elatus, Celsus: plur. גְּבֹהִים Foem. גְּבֹהָה Alta; plur. גְּבֹהוֹת.
גָּבְהוּת גָּבֹהַ m. גְּבֹהוּת f. Altitudo.
גָּבַל Terminavit, Determinavit. Hiphil הִגְבִּיל idem.
גְּבוּל m. Terminus: plur. גְּבוּלִים, Femin. גְּבוּלָה idem: plur. גְּבוּלוֹת.
מְגֻבָּלוֹת f. p. Terminata, Aequabiles, Exod. 28.14: pro מְגֻבָּלוֹת. Simile in בַּדֵּל.
גִּבַּ m. Gibbosus: Hinc tertiâ radicali geminatâ,

page.notes: Hebrew headwords are set in a small, worn type and some vowel points are hard to make out; those marked [?] are uncertain. The final entry runs on to the next page. Page number 52 is printed in italic at top right.
